PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF INFECTIOUS DISEASES ACT 1988

PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF INFECTIOUS DISEASES

(MEASURES WITHIN INFECTED LOCAL AREAS) (CONDITIONAL MOVEMENT

CONTROL) (NO. 4) (AMENDMENT) (NO. 14) REGULATIONS 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 11(2) of the

Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases Act 1988 [Act 342],

the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Prevention and Control

of Infectious Diseases (Measures within Infected Local Areas)

(Conditional Movement Control) (No. 4) (Amendment) (No. 14) Regulations 2021.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 May 2021.

Substitution of First Schedule

2. The Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases (Measures within

Infected Local Areas) (Conditional Movement Control) (No. 4) Regulations 2021

[P.U. (A) 97/2021] are amended by substituting for the First Schedule

the following schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

APPLICATION

[Regulation 2]

(1)

Infected Local Area/Division/District/Mukim

(2)

Period

1. State of Johore 29.4.2021 – 17.5.2021

2. State of Penang 29.4.2021 – 17.5.2021

3. State of Sabah 29.4.2021 – 17.5.2021

4. State of Sarawak 27.4.2021 – 17.5.2021

8. Raub District except Mukim of Gali and Tras, State of Pahang 30.4.2021 – 13.5.2021".
